description: Style browser scrollbars: track and thumb colors, width and radius, with a live demo and WebKit CSS plus the Firefox fallback.

faqs.a: WebKit/Blink browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari) use the ::-webkit-scrollbar rules; Firefox uses the scrollbar-color / scrollbar-width fallback included in the snippet.
faqs.q: Does it work in all browsers?

faqs.a: The snippet only styles scrollbars inside the element you apply the class to — your page's default scrollbar is untouched.
faqs.q: Will it style my whole page's scrollbar?

faqs.a: Set the width low and the radius high, then pick matching thumb/track colors — the live demo updates as you drag.
faqs.q: How do I get a minimal thin scrollbar?

howto: Set the scrollbar width and corner radius.
Optionally enable a thumb hover color.
Scroll the live demo, then copy the CSS.
title: Scrollbar Styler
